text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're making such a fuss, Trainer.
It's just a little pain.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on, it really was just a minor injury!
choice_data_list: Because stopping you there is my job.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I'm totally fine, though.
Being a Trainer sure sounds tough.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever! I know what condition I'm in, so let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"My body's finally warmed up nicely.
It'd be a waste to stop here!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"My body's finally warmed up nicely.
It'd be a waste to stop here!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Why are you stopping me, Trainer?! I'm totally fine with this much!
choice_data_list: It's to keep the injury from getting worse.
It's to keep the injury from getting worse, okay?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Worsen... it could worsen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
True, not being able to run because of that
might be boring.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's rest! Even the 'voice of destiny'
is telling me that's the right move!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then we've gotta decide how to spend our break right away! A café, shopping—well, once we head outside, we'll know where to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ended up double-checking what rest truly entailed.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected, Trainer!
You really get me!
choice_data_list: But I'll stop if it gets dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that works!
Though you definitely won't need to worry!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*...
choice_data_list: ...How does it feel running at an easy pace?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah. This won't do at all! You should get some rest!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No. But I realized going any further wouldn't be good.
I wouldn't have known if I hadn't run,
so I'm glad I tried it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To prevent the injury from worsening any further, we decided to have her rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!
We can do it, we're gonna make it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: How's that, Trainer? Even running at full power, it doesn't hurt at all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The 'Voice of Destiny' was right after all!
choice_data_list: Yeah, but just to be safe, let's take it easy from here on out.
Yeah, but just to be safe, let's take it easy after this.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You worry too much, Trainer.
Well, I feel refreshed after running with all my might,
so that's fine by me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Epiphaneia continued training without pushing herself too hard.
